title: Folk psychology is stagnant and explains little

statements.text: A promising theory should offer a fertile research program with considerable explanatory power. Folk psychology appears stagnant, and leaves a broad range of mental phenomena unexplained: why people dream, mental illness, consciousness, memory and learning.

sources.locator: section 3.1, 'General Theoretical Problems With Folk Psychology'
sources.quote: common-sense psychology appears to be stagnant, and there is a broad range of mental phenomena that folk psychology does not allow us to explain
